items.title: fix(status): label diagnostic-only service state (#140547)
items.summary: fix(status): label diagnostic-only service state (#140547) * fix(cli): label diagnostic-only service state in gateway status gatherDaemonStatus already decides whether the inspected service is the one the connectivity probe targets, and emits service.targetRole for it. printDaemonStatus read that role into serviceTargetsProbe but printed an unqualified "Service:" heading and an unqualified "Runtime:" line, so a retained custom LaunchAgent selector could show "Runtime: running" directly above "Connectivity probe: failed" for a different Gateway, with nothing saying the two lines describe different services. Append the existing distinction to the two lines that report that service's state, and only when the role is diagnostic-only. Service selection, targeting, casing and override rules are untouched, and the JSON branch returns before any of this runs, so machine-readable output is byte-identical. Refs #47811 rather than Fixes: the original report also covers profile targeting and cross-profile restart on a host configuration that was never reproduced. This repairs only the status presentation defect that is independently established in source. Signed-off-by: Tymofii Pidlisnyi * fix(cli): clarify diagnostic service state without extra formatters Preserve the recorded service target role on both human status lines and inline the one-use probe and capability formatters without changing their fallback behavior. Exercise the real runtime formatter across service roles and states while retaining JSON, hints, and redaction coverage. Hosted proof captured four intended baseline failures, then 198 passing owner/sibling tests with two existing platform skips. A normal build and four isolated CLI calls verified the qualifiers for an absent, stopped service; changed-file gates and cleanup passed. Production net -4 lines. Refs #47811. This repairs status presentation only. Co-authored-by: Tymofii Pidlisnyi --------- Signed-off-by: Tymofii Pidlisnyi Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: Tymofii Pidlisnyi

items.title: CISA將Chrome甫修補漏洞列入KEV清單
items.summary: 美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）9月4日發布公告，將Google Chrome的漏洞CVE-2026-85046列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），表示已有證據顯示該漏洞遭到實際利用，要求聯邦機構在9月18日前完成修補。

items.title: 微軟推出Project Zenith，打造開發者專用Windows裝置
items.summary: 微軟上周五（9/4）發表了Project Zenith，這是一套整合高階硬體與優化軟體配置、專為開發者設計的Windows體驗方案，讓開發者一開機就可以開始撰寫程式碼，外界認為這是微軟為了避免開發者因AI開發需求而流向蘋果Mac平臺，而特別設計的專案。

items.title: 多倫多大學研究揭露新型攻擊手法GPUThor，可突破Nvidia GPU的ECC防護
items.summary: 多倫多大學研究人員8月下旬公開GPUThor攻擊手法，證實這種新型Rowhammer攻擊技術可突破Nvidia GPU的ECC防護，並於採用Ampere架構與GDDR6記憶體的RTX A4000、A4500、A5000及A6000等GPU環境中完成驗證，研究團隊已於4月29日通報Nvidia，後者則在8月25日發布緩解建議。

items.title: SEMI E187驗證標章亮相，最快10月將公布第一家驗證機構，首波獲標章產品有望於年底前問世
items.summary: 由臺灣主導制定的半導體設備資安標準SEMI E187，在SEMICON Taiwan 2026正式舉行驗證標章公告儀式。這不僅是該標章的首度公開亮相，更標誌著臺灣從國際標準的跟隨者，逐步成為規則制定者與驗證體系的建構者。

items.title: 中科院傳出採購網大量派送過期資訊，起因是遭遇外部攻擊
items.summary: 系統開發商為維護方便而設下的管理介面，成為攻擊者入侵的破口！國家中山科學研究院採購資訊網日前突然送出大量過期採購資訊，相關廠商收到因而懷疑此系統可能遭到入侵，然而這起事故發生的時間，中科院剛好在測試AI代理，因此他們起初懷疑是AI出錯釀禍，但後來又改口是遭到外部入侵。
